contact.basis: Reference from independent terrain source near the central street blocks of the former fortress. Modern terrain approximates general slope and known cape grade.

verticalDatum: Copernicus GLO-30 surface elevations, EGM2008 geoid.
attribution: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 © DLR e.V. and Airbus Defence and Space GmbH
method: Unchanged values from a native Float32 raster crop, bilinearly sampled at the declared WGS84 sample centres. The independent 16 m review spacing oversamples the native approximately 30 m source.
limitations: Surface model with modern canopy, roads and harbor fill. It gives a broad approximation of the original cape grade and shows a modern shoreline.
A Terrarium candidate had several large offshore void artefacts and did not supply the reviewed terrain or model elevations.
